GRANULARITY FLAG (not an error, for human awareness): published trade sources describe the Shedgum/EWPS-1 work as a SINGLE 56 km package containing two parallel 56-inch lines named '3' and '4' ($91.89M total). GEM models these as two separate 28 km segments P6717 ('3') and P6718 ('4'), each carrying $46M (half the package).
